references.text: Jesus refers to earlier miracles with bread, asking the disciples if they do not remember the five loaves for the five thousand and how many baskets they gathered, as well as the seven loaves for the four thousand and how many baskets they gathered.
A similar event where Jesus feeds a large crowd with few resources highlights his ability to provide and perform miracles.
Jesus asks how many loaves they have before feeding five thousand men, showing a pattern of Jesus' miracles in feeding large crowds.
A parallel event where Jesus feeds four thousand men with seven loaves, which directly mirrors the event in Matthew 15:34.
